document.title: BRS-161014 Test machine ass'y Frame+Coil improvement (air-press DOE)
document.purpose: Improve Frame deform by tuning Frame+Coil assembly air-press clamp pressure.

conclusions.normalized_interpretation: All 4 air-press levels (0.14/0.24/0.34/0.40 Mpa) produce 0/50 Frame deform NG. No same-event Normal in this sheet; this is a doe_matrix where every level is acceptable on this metric.
AVG: 0.14=3.127, 0.24=3.123, 0.34=3.125, 0.40=3.127 mm. Max spread ~0.004 mm across all four conditions - effectively flat. Pressure tuning has no visible effect on SPK height.

troubleshooting_index.defect_name: Frame deform via Frame+Coil ass'y air-press

suggested_checks.check_item: Air-press clamp pressure is not the dominant Frame-deform driver
suggested_checks.reason: 0/50 NG at all 4 pressures and AVG height differs by <0.004 mm.

limitations: No same-event Normal row; sample 50 pcs per pressure.

assumptions: Result rows for 4 pressures are part of the same DOE event.
warnings: Frame deform rate is 0 in all conditions - cannot rank; small SPK height difference (<0.004 mm).
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Same-event Normal not present in this sheet. doe_matrix classification: all four conditions yield identical Frame-deform outcome. Author note 'Result same' aligns with computed AVG/MAX/MIN spread.
